title: Transcript search and message action cursor
objective: Add fast transcript search and message cursor actions on top of the virtualized transcript, including indexed search text, next/previous navigation, and stable highlight positioning.
actions: Build a lowercased search-text cache keyed by message object or stable message id.
Support entering transcript search, updating the query, and navigating matches with next/previous actions.
Jump to virtualized matches even when the target message is not currently mounted.
Display match count and current match position in bottom chrome without crowding the prompt.
Add message action cursor behavior for selecting prior user prompts and expandable tool/result rows.

criteria: Search warm-up is explicit and avoids per-keystroke full transcript lowering.
Search can jump to matches outside the mounted virtual range.
Manual scroll exits active search preview without corrupting current highlights.
Match count and current match index are visible in a compact status area.
Tests cover empty query, no matches, wraparound, virtual offscreen match, and width changes.

non_goals: Do not implement fuzzy global file search in this task.
Do not add IDE-side search integration.
Do not make search depend on Gateway or LSP availability.
findings: Added a pure transcript search index that lowers searchable message text once per query path and returns stable message indexes for offscreen virtual matches.
SwarmChatApp now supports transcript search mode from empty input, next/previous navigation, Enter-to-jump, and compact footer search summary.
VirtualConversationList accepts selected/search message indexes and renders selected rows without polluting the render cache.
